assets.name: Shack
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: one full-bleed panoramic background plate for a specific city growth level in netKonnect. Generate ONE image, wide 3:1 panorama.
Input images: reference-poster.png is the STYLE REFERENCE; meadow-v1.png is the COMPOSITION AND PALETTE REFERENCE, not a scene to duplicate.
Style/medium: hand-painted watercolor, delicate navy ink linework, visible cold-press paper grain, sage and olive green landscapes, ivory architecture, terracotta accents and pale blue glass and water. Cozy illustrated world, matching the existing art. Consistent neutral daylight; the app adds sunrise, sunset and night lighting separately.
Composition/framing: elevated side view, continuous landscape from edge to edge. Main distant landmarks and skyline occupy the upper-middle third, roughly 25–55 percent of the height, so they remain visible in a shallow UI banner. The lower 45 percent is a fully painted, low-contrast, unobstructed grassy or landscaped route corridor extending all the way from LEFT to RIGHT. Live roads and vehicles will be drawn over this band, and the main growing city will be overlaid at the far RIGHT. Keep all large background buildings and infrastructure in the middle distance, behind that corridor. Preserve legibility at a small display size. Painted sky, natural greenery and blue water extend to the image edges; no white empty space or transparent areas.
Constraints: no foreground city or large foreground buildings, no traffic vehicles, no people near the foreground corridor, no text, logos, labels, numbers, borders, collage or multiple panels. No photorealism, 3D, neon cyberpunk or dystopia. This is a distinct stage-specific world, not a recolored duplicate of the meadow reference.
City level: 1 of 20 — Shack.
Scene/backdrop: Untamed woodland clearing: rough wild meadow, scrub grass, scattered weathered boulders, a fallen log, sparse wildflowers, deep forest at the edges, distant undeveloped hills, a tiny shallow creek. This is an almost untouched frontier; no buildings, paved roads, city skyline or infrastructure anywhere.
